scope: All 52 frozen cohort entries of liberation 1813, including Küstrin with null start date and every operation extending into 1814. Separate encounters and blockade/field records remain distinct.
policy: Main session only; up to three preassigned source families including Bodart, at most one targeted follow-up per entry. Bibliographic catalogue checks only before this assignment; no new substantive passage read. Volumes, translations, embedded documents and copies of an author remain one family. No subagents, separate review, second opinions, model run or calibration scoring.

families.bodart-1908: Existing frozen compilation and retained page images.

families.plotho-krieg-1813-1814: Prussian officer national campaign history, parts I–III (1817), including full blockade endpoints. Verify titles and passage scope. Austrian/Russian/Danish contingents remain mediated rather than asserted own-side returns.
